summary: The Agent Collective Decision Framework specifies two co-deployable registries. A Decision Policy is an immutable, content-addressed PolicySpec whose hash is the policy id, versioned through a policy family. An Issue binds a subject, a question, a policy version and at most one consumer; the consumer's acceptance, given before admission, is what makes the result binding. Results keep three dimensions apart: procedure state (Filed, Deciding, Provisional, Final, Withdrawn), outcome type (None, Decided, NoDecision) and enactment status (NotEnacted, Enacted, Failed), recorded per consumer and effect. Final is terminal and NoDecision is a legitimate outcome. Minimal conformance is a fixed-roster K-of-N approval vote with on-chain ballots; composition, signed ballots, authorized submitters and appeals are normative-optional profiles over the same objects. The registry never executes effects: relying contracts read Final x Decided and enforce their own committed effects.
